## Control-Plane Artifact Formats

Follow [Artifact Formats And Ad Hoc Storage](../control-plane/framework/governance/policies/tracker-and-state.policy.md#artifact-formats-and-ad-hoc-storage).
Keep JSON and Markdown separate. Related files share an identity stem with distinct role
suffixes. Ad hoc planning has one evolving capture Markdown and proposal JSON; requests,
confirmations and ordinary source notes belong in the capture, not a growing request-file
collection. Preserve prior subjects as history. Horizon laydown changes remain deferred.

<!-- mermaid-ai-skills:start -->
## Mermaid Diagrams

When the user asks to create, edit, or visualize a Mermaid diagram, follow the
instructions in `.github/instructions/mermaid.instructions.md`.
<!-- mermaid-ai-skills:end -->

## External Diagrams And Checkpoints

For external diagram editing, Excalidraw MCP scenes, exports, or reliance on diagrams in
planning/consolidation/assessment/review, load `.github/skills/diagram-checkpoint/SKILL.md`.
The linked policy owns checkpoint triggers. Honor the selected provider and active write scope;
do not hand-edit remote-scene exports or infer lifecycle transitions from diagram work.
